about_intro: The nature of Portugal inspires my creative ideas for handmade pieces.
about_story: I love working with beads, creating interesting, beautiful bracelets, cute little bags, and ball- and heart-shaped keychains.
about_process: I also love crochet knitting with Portuguese-made cotton yarn.
about_materials: The main materials are seed beads and Portuguese-made cotton yarn.
contacts_intro: The quickest way to reach the maker is WhatsApp, Telegram or email.
privacy_reviewNotice: This page is a plain-language MVP summary and should be reviewed by the site owner or a legal advisor before relying on it.
privacy_p1: This website does not submit, process or store orders. There is no cart, checkout, or payment system.
privacy_p2: The website does not create user accounts and does not require you to register.
privacy_p3: The website does not intentionally collect or store your personal contact data. When you contact the maker via WhatsApp, Telegram, or email, that conversation takes place on the respective external service, which has its own privacy policy.
privacy_p4: No analytics, advertising, or tracking cookies are used by default.
privacy_p5: Your browser may store your selected language locally on your device (localStorage) so the site remembers your preference on your next visit.
